subject: Virtual onsite sequencing + midday buffer plan for Alex Garcia
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Virtual onsite sequencing + midday buffer plan for Alex Garcia

Hi Alex (and team),

Thanks again for taking the loop with us. I'm proposing a single-day virtual onsite on Monday, Sept 27, with the following high-level cadence (all PT):

- 09:00–09:45: Intro + leadership / product walkthrough (Marissa)
- 10:00–11:00: System design deep dive (Jonas)
- 11:15–12:00: Coding exercise (pairing) (Laura)
- 12:00–13:00: MIDDAY BUFFER / lunch break (candidate rest + interviewers catch-up)
- 13:00–13:45: Architecture & infra Q&A (Jonas)
- 14:00–14:45: Culture + role fit + hiring manager (Marissa)
- 15:00–15:30: Closing + next steps (Irene)

Notes / asks:
- Buffer: I'm intentionally inserting a 60-min midday buffer to handle overruns and give Alex a break. If everyone thinks 45 min is fine we can shorten.
- Interview order: I intentionally put system design before the coding exercise to reduce context switching; Laura, if you'd prefer the reverse please say so.
- Attachments: I attached the draft agenda and Alex's resume (for quick reference).

Alex, can you confirm availability for Sept 27 and whether you prefer an earlier start (08:30 PT) instead? Also let us know if you need any accommodations for the coding exercise.

Irene
Irene Choi
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
(irene.choi@redwoodinference.com)

Attachments: VOS_agenda_0927.pdf, alex_garcia_resume.pdf

From: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@example.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite sequencing + midday buffer plan for Alex Garcia

Thanks Irene — Monday the 27th works great. I prefer a 09:00 start if that still fits the team. The 60-minute midday break is appreciated; I’d rather have the extra time between exercises.

For the coding exercise: I normally do pair programming over VS Code Live Share and I can provide a short binary for the environment if needed. No special accommodations required.

See you then — Alex

--
Alex Garcia
Senior Software Engineer (candidate)
alex.garcia@example.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@example.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T08:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite sequencing + midday buffer plan for Alex Garcia

Irene — thanks for the draft. I have one sequencing suggestion: swap the coding exercise and the 11:15–12:00 slot so coding comes right after intro (i.e., 10:00–11:00 coding, 11:15–12:00 design). Rationale: coding tends to reveal practical constraints we can reference in the later design conversation; also helps the candidate warm up.

If we make that change I suggest trimming the midday buffer to 45 minutes (12:00–12:45) to keep the day from running late (several interviewers have meetings at 15:30).

If Jonas or Marissa object, happy to keep the original order.

Laura
Laura Bennett
Staff Engineer, Platform
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@example.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T12:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite sequencing + midday buffer plan for Alex Garcia

All — quick coordination from recruiting side.

- Alex confirmed 09:00 start; Irene please finalize and I'll send invites.
- Backup pool: I’ve assigned two backup interviewers (Kimberly Park and Marcus Lin) in case of last-minute conflicts — listed in the panel rotation matrix (attached).
- Calendar: I'll send single-day calendar invites with Zoom links and a separate 15-min "pre-brief" for interviewers at 08:30 to align expectations and scoring rubric.
- Attachments: panel_rotation_matrix.xlsx (contains primary + backup assignments)

Irene, once you finalize order I’ll publish invites and the candidate prep doc (link below).

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Recruiter, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Garcia <alex.garcia@example.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-09-17T18:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Virtual onsite sequencing + midday buffer plan for Alex Garcia — FINAL AGENDA & invites

Alex / team — final plan below. Per the quick sync we had, we accepted Laura's sequencing suggestion and kept a 45-minute midday buffer. Calendar invites will follow from Neha with Zoom links and a 08:30 interviewer pre-brief.

Final agenda (PT) — Monday, Sept 27
09:00–09:45: Intro + leadership / product walkthrough (Marissa)
10:00–11:00: Coding exercise (pairing) (Laura)
11:15–12:00: System design deep dive (Jonas)
12:00–12:45: MIDDAY BUFFER / lunch break
13:00–13:45: Architecture & infra Q&A (Jonas)
14:00–14:45: Culture + role fit + hiring manager (Marissa)
15:00–15:30: Closing + next steps (Irene)

Logistics for Alex:
- We’ll use VS Code Live Share for the coding exercise; Laura will send a short prep note with the problem format.
- Expect a 15-min interviewer pre-brief at 08:30 (invites coming).
- Please join each Zoom from the calendar invites; if you need one consolidated link, tell Neha and she’ll combine.

Interviewers: primary + backups in panel_rotation_matrix.xlsx. We’ll run a 30-min debrief block immediately after the loop (15:30–16:00) for internal scoring — recruiters and interviewers only.

Alex — can you confirm receipt and that the VS Code Live Share flow is ok? If all good, Neha will send invites tomorrow.

Thanks everyone — Irene

--
Irene Choi
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

Attachments referenced: panel_rotation_matrix.xlsx, calendar_invites.ics, VOS_agenda_0927.pdf
